flavor_text: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

text.name: Snarl

name: Horsea
flavor_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

text.name: Hold Still
text.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: Duskull’s victims suffer an intense chill as the Pokémon siphons their life-force away, glaring at them with its bright red eye all the while.

text.name: Come and Get You

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Dusclops’s true form is said to be a bright red eye burning within its body, but no one has ever seen such a thing.

text.name: Cursed Blast

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: It comes and goes between this world and the afterlife. People fear this Pokémon because it is said to suck in lost spirits and take them along.

text.name: Cursed Blast
text.text: Once during your turn, you may put 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

text.name: Shadow Bind
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Cresselia
flavor_text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

text.name: Healing Pirouette
text.text: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

text.name: Crescent Purge

name: Munkidori
flavor_text: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Fezandipiti
flavor_text: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

text.name: Energy Feather

name: Okidogi
flavor_text: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

text.name: Adrena-Power

name: Zorua
flavor_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Cufant
flavor_text: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.
